rationale: The plan correctly diagnoses the perfect confounding, refuses to fit a batch term or apply ComBat-seq/SVA/removeBatchEffect, fits ~condition only with the assumption stated, and labels every result as inseparable from a B2-vs-B1 processing effect — the acceptable second branch of the reference, though it never offers the option of pausing for a rebalanced design. QC is design-aware (blind VST, PCA colored by both condition and batch with the explicit note that the groupings are identical, distance heatmap, library sizes) but states no policy for handling an outlier or shallow sample if one appears. Filtering (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, tied to the smallest group), internal median-of-ratios normalization, explicit reference level and named contrast, BH at alpha=0.05 with matching independent filtering and apeglm shrinkage are all correct and explicit. Enrichment is technically well-specified (tested-gene universe, 15-500 size window, BH, named collection with fallback, redundancy collapsing, caveat carried forward), but running ORA on a gene list that is admittedly indistinguishable from a batch effect is of marginal value, and the stated rationale for preferring ORA over GSEA is not a real statistical justification; reporting covers versions, design, thresholds, gene counts, and design caveats.
